context:
Contract-first: the CLI output decision (w1) gates the code. Once run-official
emits its result path, the UAT resolver becomes a read, not a search, and the
whole class of substring/scale/tie-break bugs the parent hardened against
disappears at the source.
description:
Promoted from the deferred item in
[[uat-throughput-result-resolution-hardening]] (surfaced by the UAT-effort
assessment, 2026-07-16). That item hardens the filename-glob + mtime resolver
(exact platform token, scale token, deterministic tie-break, narrower nightly
window) but keeps glob resolution in principle: the official/throughput cell
still discovers its result JSON by matching filenames rather than reading a
path the producer told it. Any glob is inference; the sound fix is for
`run-official` to emit the exact result path it wrote (a small manifest or a
quiet path line) and for UAT to consume that.

Gated on the hardening item (which stabilises the glob as the interim) AND on
a `benchbox` CLI surface decision: `run-official` has no `--quiet` today, and
the parent explicitly deferred this because it "requires a benchbox CLI
surface change (run-official output contract) which the no-CLI-surface-drift
constraint makes a bigger conversation." That contract decision is the real
precondition, not just the parent's code.

anti_patterns.dont: change run-official output without updating docs/reference/public-contracts.md and passing contract review.
keep the glob as a 'just in case' fallback

deferrals.reason: Scope here is the official/throughput path; a broader producer audit is separate.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Parent item uat-throughput-result-path-manifest is still open (planning) and owns this emitted-path-contract work; broader backfill is a natural extension of it.
deferrals.summary: Backfill emitted-path contract to other non-quiet producers if any remain

preserves.behavior: No silent fallback to glob — a missing emitted path must fail loudly, or the drift this fixes returns.
resolve_official_result_path signature stays backward-compatible (per the parent item's must_preserve).

prior_art.concept: docs/reference/public-contracts.md — run-official output is a public contract surface; a new emitted-path line must be recorded here.
tests/uat/runner.py quiet result-path consumption — the existing convention every other cell uses; mirror it rather than inventing a new manifest format if possible.
tests/uat/throughput.py:resolve_official_result_path — the glob resolver this retires; preserve its signature so runner.py/nightly consumers do not churn.

verifications.description: Resolver reads an emitted path; glob body removed; contract documented
verifications.expected: no glob/mtime resolution remains; run-official emitted-path contract documented

work_units.notes:
Confirm the parent's hardened resolver landed. Inventory run-official's
current stdout/exit contract and how every other cell already uses the
quiet result-path line (tests/uat/runner.py) so the manifest mirrors an
existing convention rather than inventing one.
work_units.summary: Re-validate the hardened glob is in place and scope the run-official output contract

work_units.notes:
Decide between (a) giving run-official the same --quiet result-path line
the other cells consume, or (b) a per-run manifest file. Prefer (a) for
surface consistency unless run-official emits multiple result paths.
This is a public-contract change — must go through the contract-map /
CODEOWNERS review, not slipped in.
work_units.summary: Design the result-path contract (reuse the quiet-path convention or a per-run manifest)

work_units.notes:
Implement the chosen contract, replace resolve_official_result_path's glob
body with a read of the emitted path (keep the signature per the parent's
must_preserve), and delete the mtime-window logic. Keep a loud failure if
the path is absent rather than silently falling back to glob.

Handoff: tests/uat/runner.py's `official` branch (currently ~line 241-251)
calls resolve_official_result_path directly and does not pass or parse
`stdout_text` at all -- only the non-official `else` branch does
(last_nonempty_output_line(stdout_text)). If w1 picks the quiet-stdout-line
contract, runner.py's official branch must be updated to read that line the
same way the non-official branch already does; if w1 picks a manifest file,
runner.py must locate/pass it instead. Either way runner.py's official
branch changes, so it (and test_runner.py) must be in scope, not just the
resolver + CLI.
work_units.summary: Emit the path from run-official and switch UAT to consume it; retire the glob
